Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: ONE individual Instagram ORGANIC carousel slide for Argentine brand Cale. This is calm editorial brand content, not a direct response ad. Create a finished portrait 4:5 raster slide, 1080x1350 preferred. Never a contact sheet or multi-panel page. Plenty of negative space, light/regular modern sans-serif typography akin DM Sans, selective semibold emphasis ONLY on a few important words. Refined neutral editorial magazine feel, high legibility on mobile. Palette warm off-white #F7F4EE, white, near black #15191C, deep green #0A6B3B, pale sage #E2F4E7. No saturated decoration, no exaggerated gradients, no thick shadow or glossy 3D lettering. The provided official logo is a supporting branding reference, faithfully reproduce it small (roughly 100-130px wide on 1080px canvas) as a discreet signature: black rounded square with TWO offset green checks, faint left and vivid right, plus lowercase cale wordmark. No other brands. 70px safe margins around all important text. No huge logo, no price, no free trial text, no CTA buttons, no QR code invented, no emojis, no statistics, no claims of guaranteed results. Only render explicitly requested Spanish text, accents exact. A small slide number in bottom right.
Carousel A, slide 1 of 3. Theme: still coordinating appointments after closing. An authentic editorial photograph fills the entire frame: small Argentine hair salon at closing, warm evening light, an adult female salon owner wearing a dark apron, standing relaxed by a tidy wooden counter, looking at her phone. Natural realistic skin and anatomy, no caricature exhaustion, no luxury mansion, practical salon mirror and empty chair. Frame the person on lower right with substantial uncluttered warm neutral wall on upper left. Overlay calm black text in that empty upper left, not gigantic, regular weight with just 'Seguís' semibold. Exact headline broken in 4 balanced lines: 'Cerraste el local.' / 'Seguís coordinando' / 'turnos.' No other copy. Small Cale logo bottom left on a very discreet cream footer strip, small '01 / 03' bottom right. The image should feel like a thoughtful editorial post from a small business brand. Not an advertisement. No screen notifications, no other overlaid panels.
